answer: Each identity locks an 80-credit horizon bond and appears at each census with key-signed proof its thread is live. The roll is a public nebula map of every thread. Two keys claiming one thread burn both bonds; absence at the horizon forfeits the bond. Rented presence fails the key check, so each fake needs its own thread: 1,000 fakes lock 80,000 and pay 25,000 fees against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays one bond, one fee, keeps its share.
